column7: ReauthorizeImpersonation folded any GetUser error of the impersonating admin into "impersonating account not found", so a storage fault answered ValidateSessionToken 401 (negative-cached) and ended the StreamAuditLogs re-auth tick as PermissionDenied. It is now classifyReadError + ErrAuthStorageUnavailable (503 / Unavailable); a ceiling that could not be resolved is the same class and is no longer cached for ceilingCacheTTL (TestReauthorizeImpersonation_CeilingReadFault_NotCached). StartImpersonation (admin and target reads) and EndImpersonation (session read) answer 503 too. A positive not-found stays the refusal (TestReauthorizeImpersonation_AdminNotFound_StaysRefusal). Every path stays fail closed.
